name: fishing-rod-dead-bobber
comment: WP-4.8. entity/fishing-hook without the water: the bobber (id 1, harness kind FishingHook, so player.fishEntity is set) lands on the stone and stays in the ground. After 1200 ticks in the ground it dies (EntityFish.java:168-176) without clearing angler.fishEntity, so World.updateEntities removes it while the player still names it. At t = 1290 the right click with the rod (use_item on stone: no onItemUse, so sendUseItem, ItemFishingRod.onItemRightClick, ItemFishingRod.java:18-23) reels in that dead object: catchFish returns 2 (inGround, EntityFish.java:376-382) and the rod takes 2 damage (stack.damage 2 on the op line). The port keeps the removed bobber while the player's fishEntity names it (World::removed_entities); before WP-4.8 it recorded the gap and the rod took 0. entity_state of the bobber every 50 ticks and rng_state every tick.
